scenes.narration: Nine at night. An empty pitch. <short pause> Just you, one ball, and a keeper in your head. His name is Chalk. <short pause> You draw one line around the ball. Remember that line. <short pause> You shoot. <long pause> Over the bar. <short pause> You shout at it. It doesn't listen. <short pause> Chalk doesn't even move.

sentences.text: Just you, one ball, and a keeper in your head.
You draw one line around the ball.

scenes.narration: What went wrong? <short pause> Your foot touches the ball for about a hundredth of a second. After that, it's on its own. <short pause> Three kicks tonight, one idea: spin. How much, which way, or none at all. <short pause> By lights out, you'll score this shot.

sentences.text: Your foot touches the ball for about a hundredth of a second.
After that, it's on its own.
Three kicks tonight, one idea: spin.
How much, which way, or none at all.
By lights out, you'll score this shot.

scenes.narration: Problem one: a shot Chalk can't reach. Low and hard. <short pause> Weird fact: after a clean strike, the ball can fly faster than your foot. How?

sentences.text: Problem one: a shot Chalk can't reach.
Weird fact: after a clean strike, the ball can fly faster than your foot.

scenes.narration: First, the whip. Your thigh swings, slows, and flings your shin forward. <short pause> Then, the trampoline. The ball squashes and springs back. Your leg is way heavier, so the ball bounces off faster than your foot. <short pause> Club players your age shoot about sixty-seven kilometres an hour.

sentences.text: Your thigh swings, slows, and flings your shin forward.
The ball squashes and springs back.
Your leg is way heavier, so the ball bounces off faster than your foot.
Club players your age shoot about sixty-seven kilometres an hour.

scenes.narration: A floppy ankle is a hammer with a loose head. Some of the hit leaks away. <short pause> So: toes down, ankle locked. Hit with the middle of your laces. That's your instep. Hit near your toes, and it's about fifteen percent slower.

sentences.text: A floppy ankle is a hammer with a loose head.
Some of the hit leaks away.
Hit with the middle of your laces.
Hit near your toes, and it's about fifteen percent slower.

scenes.narration: Your foot swings like a playground swing, flat only at the bottom. Meet the ball there. <short pause> So put your standing foot beside the ball, toes at the goal. Put it behind, and your kicking foot is already rising. Hello, car alarm. <short pause> Kicking knee and chest over the ball. Eyes on it. Strike through the middle. <short pause> The line turns slowly backward: a little backspin.

sentences.text: Your foot swings like a playground swing, flat only at the bottom.
So put your standing foot beside the ball, toes at the goal.
Put it behind, and your kicking foot is already rising.
Kicking knee and chest over the ball.
The line turns slowly backward: a little backspin.

scenes.narration: Classic mistake: toes up, so the ball hits your toes. Point your toes down, lock your ankle, then swing. <short pause> Solo drill: tape a line across a wall at knee height. From ten big steps, shoot ten under it. Start at half power. <short pause> Now, for real. <short pause> Chalk dives. Too late.

sentences.text: Classic mistake: toes up, so the ball hits your toes.
Point your toes down, lock your ankle, then swing.
Solo drill: tape a line across a wall at knee height.
From ten big steps, shoot ten under it.

scenes.narration: Problem two. He builds a wall and guards the near post. <short pause> You need a ball that starts wide and bends back. You need sideways spin.

sentences.text: He builds a wall and guards the near post.
You need a ball that starts wide and bends back.

scenes.narration: New kick, new rule. Inside of your foot. This time, toes up, but the ankle stays locked: a firm, flat face. <short pause> Hit just right of centre. Wrap your foot around the ball, out to the right. Left-footed? Flip it.

sentences.text: This time, toes up, but the ankle stays locked: a firm, flat face.
Wrap your foot around the ball, out to the right.

scenes.narration: Air rushes past the ball like a crowd. <short pause> The spinning ball grabs the air and flings it to one side. Throw air one way, get shoved the other way. <short pause> That's the Magnus effect: the spin push.

sentences.text: Air rushes past the ball like a crowd.
The spinning ball grabs the air and flings it to one side.
Throw air one way, get shoved the other way.
That's the Magnus effect: the spin push.

scenes.narration: Curlers seem to bend late. They don't. They bend about the same the whole way. <short pause> But the gap from a straight line grows faster and faster. From twenty metres, the gap is almost three metres. <short pause> So to the keeper, it looks late.

sentences.text: They bend about the same the whole way.
But the gap from a straight line grows faster and faster.
From twenty metres, the gap is almost three metres.
So to the keeper, it looks late.

scenes.narration: From twenty metres, aim about three metres outside the far post. Point your standing foot there. Closer to goal? Aim less wide. <short pause> Classic mistake: aiming straight at the post. The spin pulls it back to Chalk. <short pause> Solo drill: put your bag halfway to the goal. Curl ten balls around it. <short pause> Starts wide. Comes home.

sentences.text: From twenty metres, aim about three metres outside the far post.
Classic mistake: aiming straight at the post.
The spin pulls it back to Chalk.
Solo drill: put your bag halfway to the goal.

scenes.narration: Problem three. Chalk punches it clear. You pop it up off your thigh. <short pause> Now hit it before it lands.

sentences.text: You pop it up off your thigh.
Now hit it before it lands.

scenes.narration: The ball keeps falling while you swing. <short pause> So set your standing foot early, beside where it will drop. Start your swing early. Hit it at knee height or lower.

sentences.text: The ball keeps falling while you swing.
So set your standing foot early, beside where it will drop.
Hit it at knee height or lower.

scenes.narration: Your instep is a tennis racket. Toes down, and it tilts forward. Lean back, and the ball flies over.

sentences.text: Your instep is a tennis racket.
Toes down, and it tilts forward.
Lean back, and the ball flies over.

scenes.narration: The falling ball rolls down your laces. That can give it topspin. <short pause> It flicks air up, so the spin push points down. <short pause> It dives, up to about a metre lower than with no spin.

sentences.text: The falling ball rolls down your laces.
It flicks air up, so the spin push points down.
It dives, up to about a metre lower than with no spin.

scenes.narration: Classic mistake? Smashing it. <short pause> Same angle, but the harder shot flies over. It arrives sooner, so it has less time to fall. <short pause> Fix: nose over knee, knee over ball. Hit the middle, not the bottom. Clean beats hard.

sentences.text: Same angle, but the harder shot flies over.
It arrives sooner, so it has less time to fall.
Fix: nose over knee, knee over ball.
Hit the middle, not the bottom.

scenes.narration: Solo drill: drop the ball three big steps from a wall. Let it bounce once. Volley it at the top, where it almost stops. Start soft. Stay under the tape. <short pause> Now, for real. <short pause> Under the bar.

sentences.text: Solo drill: drop the ball three big steps from a wall.
Volley it at the top, where it almost stops.

scenes.narration: Bonus kick: the chip. Same air, opposite spin. <short pause> Jab your laces under the ball, a thumb's width above the grass. Then stop your foot. <short pause> It pops up steep with backspin, flicks air down, and hangs over a rushing keeper.

sentences.text: Jab your laces under the ball, a thumb's width above the grass.
It pops up steep with backspin, flicks air down, and hangs over a rushing keeper.

scenes.narration: That first shot tonight? <short pause> Your foot came up under it. It took off steep, with backspin, like a chip. By accident. <short pause> Chip on purpose, when the keeper rushes out.

sentences.text: Your foot came up under it.
It took off steep, with backspin, like a chip.
Chip on purpose, when the keeper rushes out.

scenes.narration: The first shot again. Standing foot beside the ball. Toes down, ankle locked. <short pause> Low. Hard. In. No shouting needed. <long pause> And that line? It told you everything. A little backspin, hard and low: speed. Sideways: bend. Topspin: dive. Backspin, soft and high: float.

sentences.text: A little backspin, hard and low: speed.

scenes.narration: What if the line hardly turns? <short pause> A knuckleball turns less than once a second. <short pause> The air behind it flaps like a flag, and the ball zigzags. Chalk has no idea. Neither do you. <short pause> Nail the drive first. Then come back for the knuckleball.

sentences.text: What if the line hardly turns?
A knuckleball turns less than once a second.
The air behind it flaps like a flag, and the ball zigzags.
Then come back for the knuckleball.

scenes.narration: Half past nine. Lights out. <short pause> Your foot gets about a hundredth of a second with the ball. <long pause> Now you know how to spend it.

sentences.text: Your foot gets about a hundredth of a second with the ball.
Now you know how to spend it.
